diagnosis: GitHub workflow metadata head_sha identifies the PR head but the default pull_request checkout selected refs/pull/4/merge.
Therefore the successful pre-promotion test was merge-integration evidence, not exact execution of the candidate head.
The later exact-main push run demonstrates that the active tree passes after promotion, but cannot rewrite the prior chronology as a compliant pre-promotion exact-head check.

repair.required: Explicitly checkout the PR head SHA/push SHA and assert git rev-parse HEAD before installation or tests; preserve merge-ref evidence as a distinct integration subject when desired.
